patches.name: Pixiv Adblocker
patches.description: Eliminates bottom advertising banners across all screens without layout padding, suppresses rate-this-app dialogs, and hides sponsored works in feeds.

patches.name: Pixiv AI Work Flagger
patches.description: Identifies AI-generated works, dims thumbnails with an [AI] badge (or hides them completely), shows floating [AI] badge on artwork viewer, adds title [AI] pill, auto-blocks AI artists, and provides in-app settings with tag editor.

patches.name: Pixiv Analytics Blocker
patches.description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, Google Measurement telemetry, and internal Pixiv event logging dispatchers for enhanced privacy.

patches.name: Pixiv Downloader
patches.description: Adds a button to the illustration and manga detail view to download original full-quality artwork directly to your Photos library with clean metadata filenames.

patches.name: Pixiv OLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Overrides dark gray surface and background colors with pure pitch black (#ff000000) for OLED battery savings and true high-contrast dark mode.

patches.name: Pixiv Persistent Navigation
patches.description: Keeps the primary bottom navigation bar visible, docked, and functional when navigating into submenus and drill-down views such as SearchResultActivity and RankingActivity.

patches.name: Pixiv Premium Features
patches.description: Unlocks popularity sort sorting (popular_desc) in search, removes mute limits, and emulates client-side Pixiv Premium membership status.
